crime.value: Fatal car crash on coastal road between two rivals (Joe Dongan and Ralph Napier); classified as 'death by misadventure.' Central question: was it intentional ramming/murder, mutual suicide, or accident?
crime.quote: The slap of metal as the two cars hit is like a peal o' thunder... they're spinnin' hard toward the guardrail. They crash through, both of 'em plungin' onto the rocks below.

victim.value: Joe Dongan (and collaterally Ralph Napier). Joe is killable because he is caught between two women (Emma and Bessie), Ralph seeks revenge, and the emotional triangle creates lethal tension.
victim.quote: Ralph Napier's as smart as he is mean, and he's needlin' Joe Dongan into an attack where there'll be a killin'.

closed_world.value: Small Maine town (Bancroft, Pisquaticook County) with tight social bonds; Sheriff has limited jurisdiction. The Shore Road becomes the fatal locus—isolated coastal route with cliff and guardrail.
closed_world.quote: I reckon the next time I get a chance I'll have a word with her. After all, the cottage is in my territory. I drop around there on a Sat'dy afternoon.

culprit_and_motive.value: Ralph Napier (joint culprit with Joe, or as aggressor). Motive: rage over Joe marrying Bessie instead of the wealthy widow's inheritance benefiting Ralph's dwindling finances; class resentment; jealousy.
culprit_and_motive.quote: He yells, 'You'll never marry Bessie except over my dead body.' Ralph goes for his gun... Ralph takes off after him like a cat with salt on his tail.

resolution.value: Coroner's verdict: 'death by misadventure'—both men dead, no prosecution possible. Sheriff witnesses the crash but cannot intervene. Social resolution: Emma inherits Joe's estate; Bessie loses Joe and must grieve; the feud ends in ironic reconciliation.
resolution.quote: The coroner's verdict called it 'death by misadventure' and when you come to think on it that ain't such a bad name for what happened.

investigator.value: County Sheriff (narrator, first-person POV). Authority is limited to his county; operates in advisory capacity in Bancroft. He witnesses the crash but arrives too late to prevent it; gathers facts post-mortem.
investigator.quote: As County Sheriff I ain't got no authority in Bancroft and it ain't rightly my affair. All the same, I drop by the office of Steve Roper, Bancroft's Chief of Police.
